again? Bull shit. But one of our
kind? Not a whisper.
scene_context: With Malloy, discussing vampire rumors in Transylvania.

text:
Fictions, my friend. The vulgar
fictions of a demented Irishman...
So we repaired to Paris...
scene_context: With Malloy, discussing vampire fictions and their destination (Paris).

text:
The quest for these Old World vampires filled me with bitterness. We searched village after village,ruin after ruin and I was glad when
always we found nothing. For what
could the damned really have to say
to the damned?
scene_context: Montage: Transylvanian village, graveyard, ruined castles; Louis reflects on the quest for Old World vampires.

text: We saw the Acropolis by moonlight, shades of grey and silver. And I longed for the brilliant white of those marbles in the hot sun of Homer...
scene_context: Voice-over: Acropolis at night

text: We docked at Varna and searched the rural countryside of the Carpathians, for what she liked to term "our kind"...
scene_context: Voice-over: Transylvania and Carpathians

text: Claudia!
scene_context: Street, Louis calls Claudia's name after seeing a shadow

text: Yes...
scene_context: In a room with a mirror, Louis responds to Claudia's question about her identity.

text: Yes.
scene_context: Claudia asks if Louis wants her to be his daughter forever; Louis says 'Yes.'

text: No. The Gift of Darkness requires more than that, as you'll see.
scene_context: Louis and Malloy discussing the Gift of Darkness

text: I watched her grow yet stay the same, her doll-like face possessed of adult eyes, eerie, powerful, seductive...
scene_context: Voice-over after Louis draws Claudia away, reflecting on Claudia's appearance.

text: Then maybe so do we. Every night of our lives. He was my brother. My maker. He gave me this life, whatever it is.
scene_context: Near water, Louis and Claudia discuss Lestat's death and their existence.

text: I can't. Go away from me.
scene_context: Near water, Louis refuses to look at Claudia after her plea.

text:
Claudia and I alone seemed immune.
We kept to ourselves, pondering the
mystery of Lestat and the greater
mystery of each other.
scene_context: On a ship, Louis (V.O.) reflects on Claudia and the mystery of Lestat.

text:
We were alive again. We were in
love and so euphoric was I that I
yielded to her every desire...
scene_context: Room with Claudia and couturiers, Louis recounts his past with Claudia.

text: My last sunrise. That morning I was not yet a vampire, and I saw my last sunrise. I remember it completely, yet I don't rememberany sunrise before it. I watched the whole magnificence of the dawn for the last time, as if it were the first. And the I said goodbye to sunlight and went out to become what I became.
scene_context: Voice-over: Louis reflects on his last sunrise as a human.

text:
Though the fire seemed to spread
through the quartier, I stood on
that deck until dawn, fearful he
would come out again of the very
river like some monster to destroy
us both. And all the while I
thought, Lestat, we deserve your
vengeance. You gave me the dark
gift. And I delivered you into the
hands of death for the second time.
scene_context: On a ship in the river, Louis narrates about the fire in New Orleans and his thoughts on Lestat.

text: We reached the Mediterranean. I wanted those waters to be blue. They were black, nighttime waters and how I suffered then, straining to remember the color that a young man's senses had taken for granted, that my memory had let slip away for eternity. It was black off the coast of Italy, black off the coast of Greece, Europe itself was black.
scene_context: Voice-over during passage through the Straits of Gibralter, reflecting on the black Mediterranean waters.
